## Orientation

Work only in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/dashboard-ui (HEAD 9822923). Extend `tests/test_tmux_integration.py` in the style of the existing popup lifecycle tests. For the copy check, OSC 52 reaches the tmux buffer only when the isolated server has `set-clipboard on` (server option) and the client terminal allows it; set it on the isolated server and read back with `show-buffer`. If OSC 52 cannot reach the buffer in the pty harness, say so and assert the notification instead. The manual sign-off criterion belongs to the user. Capture text frames of the filtered dashboard and a commit screen from the real store (read-only) in an 80-column side pane to /tmp/dashboard-shots/.
